sql: SELECT TOP 10 o.ClassNumber AS returnNumber, os.OrderStateName AS returnStatus, o.OldClassNumber AS orderNumber FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState os ON os.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId WHERE oc.ClassCode = @orderClass AND (@order IS NULL OR o.OldClassNumber = @order) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR o.ClassNumber = @preferred) ORDER BY o.CreatedDate DESC, o.ClassNumber DESC
